trial_court: Additional Principal Judge, Family Court Kinnaur at Rampur Bushehar, Cr. Revision No. 353 of 2022
case_name: Amar Singh vs Bimla Devi And Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: Bimla Devi and Ors. (wife and others)

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a petition under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. for granting monthly maintenance @3,000/- each. Marriage between parties was solemnized in November 1995. Petitioners are wife and two children, one physically handicapped. Respondent changed behavior after birth of third child, started beating petitioner, humiliated her repeatedly. She left matrimonial home in June 2010.

legal_principles.principle: The term 'living in adultery' does not constitute a continuous act of adultery.
legal_principles.held: The learned Trial Court erred in holding that the term 'living in adultery' would constitute the continuous act of adultery, which is not the correct position of law.
cited_cases: Amar Singh vs Bimla Devi And Ors on 18 July, 2024

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that the petitioner is living in adultery.
legal_principles.held: It was duly proved on record that petitioner No.1 was living in adultery and had refused to reside with the respondent-husband without any reasonable cause.
cited_cases: Amar Singh vs Bimla Devi And Ors on 18 July, 2024

outcome.final_order: Maintenance @1,500/- per month was awarded to each of the petitioners from respondent from the date of filing of the petition.
